stop_rule: Complete the fixed2000-update native schedule or stop at predeclared resource cap. Four hours is a maximum,not permission for selective test-EIG extensions. Capped/incomplete runs retain that status.
paired_initialization: Same actor weights,critic,posterior,replay and new-module seed within each101-105 learned/uniform pair. Seed101 actor digests verified identical.
objectives: Only native full-horizon variational EIG for both MoE methods;discount1,use_PCE=False;no balancing/diversity/cost rewards.
uniform: Same four-expert architecture,private encoders,fusion/action head;weights fixed[.25,.25,.25,.25] throughout train/target/evaluation;router parameters unused and frozen.

evaluation.selection: Terminal checkpoint only;no test-bank selection or tuning.

extracted_experts: Four independently executable current-expert policies with common context,from each completed learned checkpoint. No extra training. They inherit pretraining and mixture training;not independently optimized single experts.
pretraining_scope: Shared pretrained initialization:continuation-seed robustness,not independent from-scratch variability. Known inherited actor lineage16001 updates/16,021,000 episodes. Report inherited/offline costs separately.
baseline_policy: Reuse valid existing DAD,vsOED,RL-sBOED,ScoreBED training/checkpoints and compatible EIG vectors. Reevaluate only where bank/scorer/checkpoint differs. No baseline retraining queued. Historical resource departures remain explicit.
statistics: Five-seed mean/SD and paired seed-level intervals;case MCSE separate. Holm family protection for uniform/four experts/four externals;strongest-expert selection protected by simultaneous expert comparisons. Hypotheses may fail.
publication_decision: Formal protocol does not certify convergence or scientific success. Complete all five seed pairs,evaluation identities,resource audit and independent-path checks before promoting results.
